backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a change removing background gradient from the celebration screen.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file mapping frontend source paths to their short descriptions.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme variables defining a Valentine's color palette and general app styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app with Valentine-themed metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component managing state, evasive button logic, celebration mode, and layout.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Overlay component rendering fireworks, sparkles, and animated hearts after celebration.
frontend/src/components/InitialBackgroun: Generates animated floating gradient particles for the initial screen background.
frontend/src/components/InitialFloatingH: Empty placeholder file for floating hearts component.
frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts: Static configuration for Valentine text strings and celebration messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing a backend actor tied to Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Hook that computes random safe positions to move an evasive button within a container.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hook managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and authentication state.
frontend/src/index.css: Primary stylesheet defining theme variables, layout, animations, and visuals for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state and metadata, including one known issue about background removal and a corresponding existing feature request.
